title: Data source research candidate
description: One evaluated candidate from the research-sources skill. File name: research/candidates/<slug>.json

gap.description: the gap this was searched for, verbatim from the run's instructions

granularity.description: e.g. tract, county, MSA, ZCTA, national

history.description: how far back data goes, relevant to backtest usefulness

license.description: ToS / commercial-use summary and any attribution requirement

verified.description: true only if a direct fetch of the source's own page confirmed the facts above in this session; false if based on search-engine summaries of third-party pages only

correlation.description: quantitative evaluation vs FHFA HPI / Zillow ZORI from app/research/evaluate_series.py; null if that script doesn't exist yet or wasn't run

fits_existing_gap_in_code.description: concrete pointer into the codebase this would plug into or fix, if any

recommendation.description: one paragraph, explicit recommend/don't-recommend and why
